notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
